name: statusline
description: Status rows above the prompt (context fill, 5h and 7d limits, model, session, branch, turns) plus a per-session snapshot file other tools can read. Replaces a statusLine command.

enabled.title: Show the status rows
enabled.description: Kill switch. Off draws nothing and writes nothing.

snapshotDir.title: Snapshot folder
snapshotDir.description: Each session writes <session id>.json here (rendered line + raw numbers) every 30 seconds, for other tools to read. Empty turns it off. ~ is your home.
